description: This C# source file defines extension methods for managing grain reminders in Orleans, including registration, unregistration, and retrieval of reminders, specifically for grains implementing IRemindable. It introduces methods to streamline reminder management using extension techniques.

classes.name: GrainReminderExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods to manage reminders in Orleans grains and grain bases.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a persistent, reliable reminder for a Grain or IGrainBase, requiring the grain to implement IRemindable.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered reminder for a Grain or IGrainBase.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a registered reminder by name for a Grain or IGrainBase.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Returns all reminders registered by a Grain or GrainBase.

methods.name: GetReminderRegistry
methods.description: Accesses the reminder registry service for a given grain context.
